skill.summary: Guide to set up and configure IM channels(Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu, Dingtalk) for OpenClaw.

latestVersion.changelog:
channels-setup 1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive setup instructions for configuring Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu, and Dingtalk channels in OpenClaw.
- Includes CLI commands and configuration file examples for each channel.
- Provides guidance on restarting the gateway and environment prerequisites.
- Adds references to detailed setup guides for each channel.
